name: @phus/cli
description: The Phus CLI bin — `phus` (no args) wakes the TUI; every subcommand runs here. See documents/Proposal-Monorepo-Split.md §4.

scripts.build: rm -rf .tsbuildinfo dist && tsc --sourceMap false --declarationMap false && node ../../scripts/fix-extensions.mjs dist && node ../../scripts/rename-cli-bin.mjs dist
scripts.build:js: rm -rf .tsbuildinfo dist && tsc --sourceMap false --declarationMap false && node ../../scripts/fix-extensions.mjs dist && node ../../scripts/rename-cli-bin.mjs dist
scripts.build:full: rm -rf .tsbuildinfo dist && tsc && node ../../scripts/fix-extensions.mjs dist && node ../../scripts/rename-cli-bin.mjs dist
